versions.content: Service Name Bmc_FetchAdd_s Syntax Bmc_AtomicSType Bmc_FetchAdd_s ( volatile Bmc_AtomicSType * Object, Bmc_AtomicSType Operand ) Service ID [hex] 0x54 to 0x57 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Operand Value for the operation Parameters (inout) Object Object Parameters (out) None Return value Bmc_AtomicSType The value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects Description Atomically replaces the value pointed to by Object with the result of the addition applied to the value pointed to by Object and the given Operand. Available via Bmc.h
